details.biography: Ayella Butts is a Producer and Executive Producer known for Vigil (2021) Ridley Road (2021) and My Left Nut (2020) Ayela joined Firebird Pictures from BBC Drama Commissioning, where she worked as a Commissioning Executive. During her time at the BBC, Ayela championed exciting new voices for BBC3, executive producing shows including Nicôle Lecky’s Mood and Lauren Sequeira’s Domino Day, as well as working on some of the biggest BBC1 shows of recent years including The Gold, The Pursuit of Love, Small Axe and Ridley Road.
details.name: Ayela Butt
